title: A visit full of surprises
text:
Great visit. Our 3 teens really liked this obscure tour with its anecdotes and true stories.
We really enjoyed Caroline's tour.
author: annelaurep105

title: A night visit... captivating!
text:
We had 2 very nice visits with Caroline 5 years ago. 
This time, it was Jaime, Caroline’s companion and Sevillian who told us the history and the “obscure” legends of the city. It was a captivating, rich and... fun visit!

Thanks to Jaime for his anecdotes and...his humor:)
author: Voyageurs92400

title: Great night ride
text: Original tour that allows you to discover Seville from a different angle from the classic visits. Plus very nice guide. Anyway!
author: YannC78745

title: Magic!
text: Thank you to Caroline and her team for this beautiful highlight of Seville.  Isabel explained the cathedral beautifully.  As for Filippo, he took us back in time with these legends around Seville: a magnificent experience that I recommend.
author: NorthStar407440

title: Rich and pleasant
text:
We took the walk of the Dark Seville with Caroline, and we can guarantee that it only gave more depth and meaning to our stay.

Caroline knew immediately to plunge us into the Seville of the Middle Ages, the Moorish era and the Sephardics, it was very exciting and interesting as a visit. 

And finally, Caroline was kind and kind enough to point us to the good addresses of the city, things to do in Seville and even gave us the codes of the daily Andalus to find ourselves there during our stay.

Thank you Caroline for this little time spent together, and see you soon!
author: Ramigassem

title: Beautiful discovery
text: A very nice walk through the streets of Seville with Caroline who is a fantastic guide. Mysterious and factual visit. Thank you.
author: VincianeHa

title: Top experience
text:
Exciting visit to the secrets of Seville, very well told by Caroline and very accessible for children, thank you!
We highly recommend!
author: Voyager821426

title: Great experience
text: Great visit thanks to Caroline who is an excellent guide. Caring, available and full of anecdotes. We highly recommend
author: Jason L

title: To do essential
text: The exchanges and the discovery of unusual places that reflect the liveliness and creative bubbling Seville. Lupe is a very good guide who makes the life of Seville
author: E119YEpierrel

title: Must-see
text:
Very rewarding experience with Caroline in the morning, we did not see the 3h30 of the visit, Caroline adapts to her clients and does not serve at all cooked! Ideal to get to know this superb city.
We also enjoyed the night tour with Filipo , the humor of the guide and the charm of the Sevillian alleys at night: not to be missed!!
Thank you Caroline for your good advice... good continuation in your Sevilla life
Sylvie and Hervé
